- Real Roku risks: wifi bitrate (3 files > 30 Mbps), forced-first English sub (S03E01, S03E10), Dragon Ball remux (55.8 Mbps, TrueHD default, Japanese-only audio).
- Ozark S03 is **SDR bt709 in 10-bit HEVC at 2160p** (checked per frame, not a mis-tag): plays fine, just not HDR.
- Android "Transcode" only applies away from home (Tailscale bitrate cap, guess). At home those rows are DirectPlay.
- `[guess]` rows are unverified; Phase 2 (logs) and Phase 6 (PlaybackInfo with real device profiles) must confirm or kill them.
- Subtitle pick uses user `shawn`'s real settings (SubtitleMode=Always, sub/audio lang eng, PlayDefaultAudioTrack=False). The Roku app may still
